evidence.quote: THEOREM/INPUT: conditional on declared historyH, an ACTUAL m-row old archive is exchangeable; its labels are finite binary strings, potentially on a COUNTABLE alphabet. The target Q_H is fixed givenH; new target samples/fresh bits are conditionally independent of the archive. No finite explicit alphabet or IID old-row hypothesis is needed for the OUTPUT law. Target choice from a permutation-invariant history such as the archive histogram is allowed if conditional exchangeability actually holds. Arbitrary ordered-row/adaptive history is not automatically allowed. This is a stronger BATCH contract, not the one-distinguished-old-X theorem.
